# gate run, each with its default read from the parsing code rather than a
# nearby comment:
#   MEDIAGIT_AUTO_GC_INTERVAL              default 100   auto_gc.rs:158
#   MEDIAGIT_PACK_VERIFY_CONCURRENCY       default 16    handlers/repo.rs:1163
#   MEDIAGIT_PACK_VERIFY_PACK_CONCURRENCY  default 1     handlers/repo.rs:1485
#   MEDIAGIT_PACK_VERIFY_BUDGET_SECS       default 300   handlers/repo.rs:1448
# (MEDIAGIT_ALLOW_MULTI_INSTANCE was added in the same pass.)
# THE REMAINING 3 ARE FALSE POSITIVES of a lexical scan, verified individually:
#   MEDIAGIT_APP_  MEDIAGIT_AUTHOR_  MEDIAGIT_COMMIT_EDITMSG_
# Each is a FAMILY STEM captured without its suffix, not a variable anyone can
# set. Documenting them would mean inventing three knobs to satisfy a metric.
# NOTE, and this is the interesting part: this gate asks whether a knob is
# DOCUMENTED, never whether it WORKS. On the same day it sat at 8, env-knobs.md
# was listing 14 knobs as "stable" that are read only inside
# `apply_env_overrides` -- a function with no live caller. Fully documented,
# entirely inert, and green here throughout. See the blind-spot note in
# 14_docs_surface.ps1.
# 3 -> 2 on 2026-09-11 (v0.4.0). Not a documentation change: `MEDIAGIT_APP_`
# stopped appearing in the code at all. It was a stem captured from
# MEDIAGIT_APP_NAME/_PORT/_HOST/_ENVIRONMENT/_DEBUG inside `apply_env_overrides`,
# and that function was deleted along with the 14 inert knobs it was the sole
# reader of (FUTURE_TODOS items 22/23). So one of the three accepted false
# positives went away by deleting the dead code that produced it.
# Ratcheted rather than left at 3, on this file's own precedent (8 -> 3): a
# baseline held above the real number stops catching regressions in the gap.
# The remaining 2 are still FAMILY STEMS, not settable variables:
#   MEDIAGIT_AUTHOR_  MEDIAGIT_COMMIT_EDITMSG_
# If this number RISES, a knob was added without documenting it.
# It nearly did this release: MEDIAGIT_GC_GRACE_SECS shipped in the gc prune
# grace period documented only in CHANGELOG and code comments, and was added to
# env-knobs.md before the campaign rather than after a 2.5h run found it.
